name: 蜡烛
pitch_facts: Our factory is based in Ningjin, Hebei — the hometown of birthday candles, a cluster that supplies roughly 60% of the world's birthday candles.
The cluster works like one giant production line: hundreds of specialized workshops each master a single step or category, and full-chain manufacturers handle R&D to finished product.
We offer free samples for candle products — free sampling and free shipping for evaluation.
For our regular market products, there is no minimum order quantity (MOQ).
For customized products, we can discuss details based on your specific requirements.
